retirement.reason: Corollary 4.3 is now proved the way Tasaki proves it, by contraposition from Theorem 4.2, so the sub-cubic staggered-susceptibility assumption and the conditional reduction that consumed it were removed from the Lean tree; nothing replaces the assumption, whose content was strictly stronger than the corollary it was fed into.

records.summary: An assumption of this project, not a transcription of a published estimate: for every positive margin there is a ring-size threshold beyond which the static staggered susceptibility of every normalized ground state on an even one-dimensional antiferromagnetic Heisenberg ring is at most that margin times the cube of the ring length.

Converse of the Theorem 4.2 reduction, proved without any documented axiom: the conclusion of Theorem 4.2 implies the scalar staggered-field energy-gain condition that the reduction consumes, so the two statements are inter-derivable in Lean and the documented axiom is exactly as strong as the theorem it stands in for.
